technique_name: Write an article about the use of AI in healthcare.
description: AI is continuing to revolutionize the healthcare industry, providing more efficiencies, clinical insights, and cost savings. AI-enabled tools are being used to automate mundane tasks and free up clinicians' time, diagnose diseases faster and more accurately, provide personalized treatments, monitor patient progress, and even predict potential health conditions before they happen.
